name: Ripio wMXN
oneLiner: WMXN is Ripio's Mexican-peso wrapped fiat stablecoin, issued and redeemed through Ripio's wFIAT on/off-ramp infrastructure against local-currency reserves.
collateral: Mexican-peso fiat cash deposited in a Mexican bank account, backing Ripio wMXN one-to-one against the Mexican peso per Ripio's wFIAT token certification
pegMechanism: Issuer-controlled wFIAT token: the Ripio affiliate mints WMXN against local Mexican-peso reserves and burns supply as needed, holding 1 WMXN = 1 MXN through on/off-ramp convertibility on Ripio and other VASP platforms plus DEX arbitrage; holders have no contractual on-chain redemption right

sources.label: Independent public accountant certification for wMXN - March 2026

mintAuthority.summary: WMXN is an issuer-managed Ripio wFIAT token. All chains use the same contract address with identical role holders: EOA 0x466c02e2 (DEFAULT_ADMIN + MINTER), Safe 0x2b839174 (4/7, DEFAULT_ADMIN), and two AccessControl minter-router contracts whose own admins are the same EOA and Safe.

controls.label: Ripio shared WMXN admin and MINTER_ROLE holder (EOA)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295015, hasRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE) and hasRole(MINTER_ROLE) both returned true. eth_getCode returned 0x (EOA). Same role confirmed via hasRole on Base, BSC, Polygon, Gnosis, and Worldchain at same block range.

controls.label: Ripio WMXN Safe multisig (DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295015, hasRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE) returned true. getOwners() returned 7 owners; getThreshold() returned 4. getModulesPaginated returned empty array (no modules). slot0 masterCopy = 0x41675c...61a (Safe v1.4.1 singleton). fallbackHandler = 0xfd0732...ec99 (standard CompatibilityFallbackHandler). getGuard() reverted (no guard).

controls.label: Ripio WMXN Ethereum minter-router contract
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295015, hasRole(MINTER_ROLE) returned true on WMXN token. Contract is an AccessControl contract with DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE holders confirmed as 0x466c02e2 (EOA) and 0x2b839174 (Safe). Not deployed on other chains (eth_getCode = 0x on Base).

controls.label: Ripio WMXN cross-chain minter-router contract
controls.evidence: At block 25295015, hasRole(MINTER_ROLE) returned true on WMXN token on Ethereum, Base, BSC, Polygon, and Gnosis. Contract is an AccessControl contract with DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE holders confirmed as 0x466c02e2 (EOA) and 0x2b839174 (Safe).

review.evidence: All mint-capable role holders verified via hasRole() across Ethereum, Base, BSC, Polygon, Gnosis, and Worldchain at block 25295015. EOA 0x466c02e2 confirmed via eth_getCode. Safe 0x2b839174 confirmed as 4/7 Safe v1.4.1 with no modules or guard. Minter-router contracts 0xd168cfbb and 0x46167cb0 confirmed as AccessControl contracts whose admins are the same EOA and Safe.

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Ripio wMXN is centrally issued across multiple EVM chains; the public source confirms issuer-managed wFIAT mechanics but does not prove a holder-level blacklist path.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: Ripio describes wMXN as a wrapped local stablecoin for on-chain usage, and candidate route evidence includes Across and World Chain. Because external liquidity/intent routing is material, the route is scored as liquidity/intent.

params.label: Mexican-peso fiat deposits in a Mexican bank account

sources.label: Independent public accountant certification for wMXN - March 2026

reserveReview.rationale: The March 31, 2026 certification reconciles 518,689 outstanding wMXN across six chains and MXN937,364.13 of collateral to a Mexican bank statement, then certifies that all outstanding tokens are backed by Mexican pesos at a financial institution in Mexico. The engagement is expressly a certification, not an audit or review, and the bank and account terms are not disclosed.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Independent public accountant certification of the wMXN collateral as of March 31, 2026
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: No reserve asset class is unclassified; the Mexican financial institution, account type, and withdrawal liquidity are undisclosed.
